about.title: Barstow Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Barstow sits at a crossroads of heavy through-traffic, with I-15, Main Street, and Lenwood Road carrying commuters, commercial trucks, and travelers passing through San Bernardino County every day. Among the 63 injury collisions recorded in the most recent final crash year, three resulted in traffic deaths — each one a family whose life changed in an instant. If you've lost a spouse, partner, parent, or child in a Barstow traffic collision, California law gives you a path to seek accountability, but that path has strict rules about who may file and how much time you have. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we're a free service that connects grieving families with independent attorneys who understand wrongful death claims and work without charging anything unless they recover compensation for you. You shouldn't have to figure out legal deadlines while you're grieving. We can help you find someone who will explain your options clearly and handle the legal work while you focus on your family.

whyChoose.title: What Families in Barstow Should Understand About Wrongful Death Law

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible only in certain circumstances. An attorney can help determine who in your family qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim in California, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity — like a public road authority — may be involved. Waiting too long can permanently close the door on your family's claim.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Funeral Bill
items.desc: California law allows families to seek recovery for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. These civil claims are separate from any criminal case that may also be pending.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim after a crash in Barstow?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit. If the crash involved a government-owned road or a public entity vehicle, the deadline to act is much shorter, so it's worth speaking with an attorney as soon as you're able.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring this kind of claim?
items.answer: California law prioritizes a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children as the people entitled to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing under certain conditions. An attorney can review your family's situation and clarify who should be named in the claim.

items.question: Does a wrongful death case relate to any police investigation of the crash?
items.answer: No, they're separate processes. A criminal case, if one is filed, is handled by prosecutors and addresses potential criminal penalties, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action your family pursues independently to seek financial recovery. One can move forward regardless of the outcome or timing of the other.
